about: Controls while locked on with a covered sword in the right hand. Read through Elden Ring's own action layer (FD4PadManager in-game pad, UserInputKey), so the player's key remaps apply. 'Suppress' = the game does not see the input this frame (virtual device state blanked).

columns.when: Condition for the row to apply
columns.suppress_for_game: true = Elden Ring does not get this input while the row applies
columns.default_pad: Elden Ring default on a controller

rows.action: Move the star cursor; the zone is the KCD2 sector the cursor points into
Point the star cursor; it stays on the last zone when the stick is released
Guard toward the cursor's zone (defense rules)
Switch to the next target (one frame of sideways camera input is passed to the game) instead of releasing lock-on
Release lock-on (one press is passed to the game)
